statements.statement: A resident proposed redirecting money to fund an extra EMS firefighter at Town Meeting; the town manager said the FY19 budget is balanced as it stands.
The Monty Tech assessment came in lower than planned and the savings went to reduce fire truck borrowing.

warnings.prediction: Adding the firefighter in one year would require overtime coverage and shift the cost to borrowing for the capital plan.
